sentences.text: Gaucher disease type III and Gaucher disease perinatal lethal are both recorded as caused by the gene GBA1 [e_efbbf071d930] [e_66faea27b5a4].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from Orphanet and OMIM [e_efbbf071d930] [e_66faea27b5a4].
Constellate computed that the two forms share this causal gene, at confidence 0.95 [e_b8af2f931bae].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_b8af2f931bae].
For type III, slowed horizontal eye movements are listed as frequent, with a confidence of 0.6 [e_22120b66707c].
Avascular necrosis, which is bone tissue dying from lack of blood supply, is also listed for type III as very frequent [e_750e6429bb40].
These edges do not show how the perinatal lethal form looks, because no symptoms are listed for it [e_66faea27b5a4].
They also show no studies and no treatments for either form [e_b8af2f931bae].
